fact: The World Bank mission reports a contracted System Integrator (Ooru) building a digital ID with working prototypes of a Verifiable Credentials Infrastructure and an electronic Signature service, with e-signature planned for May 2026.

India's Ministry of External Affairs says Ooru Digital is implementing a MOSIP-based National Digital Identity system and a National Citizen Portal for São Tomé and Príncipe, enabling access to public services through National ID-based login, and that the portal was launched on 27 March 2026.
